confederation.region_description: South American qualifying: one 10-team home-and-away league table. Top six qualified directly; seventh advanced to the inter-confederation playoff.
confederation.qualification_summary: All 10 CONMEBOL teams played a double round-robin league from September 2023 to September 2025. Argentina, Ecuador, Colombia, Uruguay, Brazil, and Paraguay qualified directly. Bolivia finished seventh and advanced to the inter-confederation playoff, where it lost to Iraq.

teams.summary: Argentina finished 1 in the CONMEBOL league table with 38 points. CONMEBOL winners.
Ecuador finished 2 in the CONMEBOL league table with 29 points. CONMEBOL runners-up.
Colombia finished 3 in the CONMEBOL league table with 28 points. CONMEBOL third place.
Uruguay finished 4 in the CONMEBOL league table with 28 points. CONMEBOL fourth place.
Brazil finished 5 in the CONMEBOL league table with 28 points. CONMEBOL fifth place.
Paraguay finished 6 in the CONMEBOL league table with 28 points. CONMEBOL sixth place.

teams.elimination_method: CONMEBOL seventh place; lost inter-confederation playoff final to Iraq
teams.summary: Bolivia finished 7 in the CONMEBOL league table with 20 points. CONMEBOL seventh place; lost inter-confederation playoff final to Iraq.
Venezuela finished 8 in the CONMEBOL league table with 18 points. CONMEBOL eighth place.
Peru finished 9 in the CONMEBOL league table with 12 points. CONMEBOL ninth place.
Chile finished 10 in the CONMEBOL league table with 11 points. CONMEBOL tenth place.

rounds.description: Single 10-team double round-robin. Top six qualified directly for the World Cup; seventh advanced to the inter-confederation playoff.
Bolivia, the seventh-place CONMEBOL team, entered the inter-confederation playoff. Bolivia beat Suriname in a semi-final and lost to Iraq in the final.

groups.notes: All 10 CONMEBOL teams in one table.

standings.notes: Ecuador total reflects a three-point deduction before qualification began.
